info.description: Backend REST API for BTMI Market - Seller Platform
info.title: BTMI Market API

post.description: Register a new user account. The account will be created with PENDING_VERIFICATION status.

201.description: Account created. Please activate your account.

get.description: Activate a user account using the token received via email. Token is valid for 24 hours and can only be used once.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The activation token from the email

post.description: Resend the account activation email. Invalidates the previous activation token.
Login with email and password. Account must be activated first.
Refresh access token using a valid refresh token. The old refresh token is revoked.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or revoked refresh token

post.description: Logout by revoking the refresh token.
Create a new business. The authenticated user becomes the OWNER.

get.description: List all businesses for the authenticated user.
Get a specific business by ID. User must have an active membership.

post.description: Create a new shop under the business. Only OWNER or ADMIN can create shops.

get.description: List all shops belonging to the business.
Get a specific shop by ID.

patch.description: Update shop details. Only OWNER or ADMIN can update shops.

post.description: Create a new employee under the business. Only OWNER or ADMIN can create employees.

get.description: List all employees belonging to the business.
Get a specific employee by ID.

patch.description: Update employee details. Only OWNER or ADMIN can update employees.

post.description: Assign an employee to a shop. Employee and shop must belong to the same business.

get.description: List all shops assigned to the employee.

delete.description: Remove employee from a shop. Only removes the assignment, does not delete the employee.

404.description: Employee, shop, or assignment not found

get.description: List all employees assigned to a specific shop.

post.description: Create a new product under the business. Only OWNER or ADMIN can create products.

get.description: List all products belonging to the business.

patch.description: Update a product's details including publication_status, category_id, and subcategory_id. Only OWNER or ADMIN can update products.

get.description: Get a specific product by ID within a business. Only OWNER or ADMIN can view products.

post.description: Add stock to a shop. Only OWNER or ADMIN can add stock. Creates a STOCK_IN movement.
Record a sale from a shop. Decreases inventory atomically. Supports PHYSICAL and ONLINE sale types.

403.description: Forbidden or employee not assigned to shop

get.description: Get all inventory items for a shop with product details.
Get all stock movements for a shop (history of all stock changes).

post.description: Reserve stock for an online order. Atomically reserves quantity.
Release previously reserved stock.
Create a new variant for a product.

get.description: List all variants for a product.

post.description: Receive stock via a multi-line receipt. Creates stock movements and updates inventory.

get.description: List all stock receipts for a business.
Get a variant by ID.
Get inventory across all shops for a specific variant.
Get a stock receipt with all its lines.

post.description: Create a new order for a shop. Reserves stock for all order lines atomically.

get.description: List all orders for a shop.
List all orders across all shops in a business.
Get a single order with its lines and status history.

post.description: Accept a pending order. Stock remains reserved.
Reject a pending order. Releases reserved stock.
Move order to PREPARING status.
Complete an order. Deducts on_hand stock, releases reserved, creates SALE_ONLINE stock movement.
Cancel an order. Releases reserved stock.

get.description: Get recent stock update events for real-time monitoring.
Get filtered stock movement history for a shop. Supports filtering by date range, movement type, product, variant, employee. Returns paginated results sorted by created_at DESC by default.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by movement type (STOCK_IN, SALE_PHYSICAL, SALE_ONLINE, etc.)

get.description: Get filtered stock movement history for a specific variant across all shops (or one shop via shop_id filter).
Get filtered stock movement history across all shops in a business.
List all cash sessions for a shop
Get cash summary for a shop
List cash payments for a shop
Get a cash session by ID

post.description: Close a cash session by declaring the physical cash amount counted
Reconcile a closed cash session, comparing expected vs actual cash

get.description: List all cash payments linked to a cash session
Get a cash payment by ID
List all cash sessions for a business
Get cash summary for an entire business across all shops
List all cash sessions for an employee
Get the authenticated buyer's profile.

post.description: Create a buyer profile for the authenticated user.

get.description: Get the authenticated buyer's point account: lifetime_points (drives level), available_points (current minus reserved), reserved_points (held by pending orders) and level name.
Get the authenticated buyer's point transaction history.
Get pending purchases awaiting buyer confirmation.

post.description: Confirm a purchase.

get.description: List all categories. Pass with_subcategories=true to include nested subcategories within each category.

parameters.name: with_subcategories
parameters.description: When true, returns subcategories nested within each category

get.description: List subcategories for a specific category.
List all active categories in the marketplace.
List subcategories for a category by slug.
List published products in a category, optionally filtered by subcategory and city.
Get ranked top shops for a category.
List public shops. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
Get public shop detail. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
List public products. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
Get public product detail. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
Get buyer-level price for a product. Requires authentication.
Get detailed shop information with categories. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
List products for a specific shop with filtering. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by product name or SKU

get.description: Get detailed product information with variants, stock, and personalized pricing. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
Get similar products for a given product. Optional authentication for buyer-level pricing.
Search products across the marketplace.
Get seller point account for a business.
Get seller level for a business.
Get level benefits for a seller business.
Get points transaction history for a seller business.

post.description: Preview order totals and point redemption for a buyer without creating the order. Points are NOT consumed or reserved. Returns base_total, points_used, points_discount_amount, final_total, available_points and maximum_usable_points (capped by the configurable max point coverage of the order total).

400.description: Invalid request body or invalid shop ID

404.description: Buyer profile, point account, shop, variant, product or inventory not found

409.description: Insufficient stock for one or more items

post.description: Create a buyer order, optionally redeeming points. When use_points=true, points are atomically reserved inside the same database transaction as stock reservation (available -> reserved -> consumed on completion; released on reject/cancel). Passing idempotency_key prevents duplicate submissions.

400.description: Invalid request, inactive shop, or insufficient points

404.description: Buyer profile, shop, variant or inventory not found

409.description: Insufficient stock or duplicate order for the same idempotency_key

get.description: List the authenticated buyer's orders, newest first. Each order includes point reservation fields (base_total, points_used, points_discount_amount, final_total).
Get a single buyer order by ID, including its lines with price snapshots (base_unit_price, points_discount_per_unit, final_unit_price). The buyer can only access their own orders.

403.description: Forbidden - the order does not belong to the buyer

get.description: List the delivery options available for a buyer order. PICKUP is always available (0 CDF); SHOP_DELIVERY uses the shop's configured fee; PARTNER is offered only when the shop has a real configured partner provider. Fees are always derived from the backend shop config.

post.description: Select the delivery method + address for a buyer order. If use_points_for_delivery is true, delivery points are atomically reserved. Changing delivery before a payment exists releases the previous delivery point reservation and recalculates the fee. PICKUP never requires an address and its fee is always 0.

400.description: Invalid method, address required, insufficient points, or invalid status

409.description: PAYMENT_ALREADY_CREATED - delivery cannot change once a payment exists

post.description: Non-spending preview of delivery point redemption for an order that already has a delivery method selected.

404.description: Order or point account not found

post.description: Non-spending preview of product point redemption for an existing buyer order.

404.description: Order or point account not found

post.description: Create a CASH payment for a buyer order. All amounts are derived server-side from the Order + Delivery snapshot (the client never sends amounts): cash_due = products_final_total + delivery_fee_final. Creating again returns the existing payment (idempotent).

get.description: Get the payment for a buyer order.

post.description: The buyer confirms cash was paid. Idempotent - confirming again returns the current state. The payment becomes VERIFIED when the seller has also confirmed, which enqueues an Asynq job that the Go worker uses to redeem reserved points and award buyer/seller points.

A seller employee (or business owner/admin) confirms cash was received. Authorization requires access to the payment's shop. Idempotent - confirming again returns the current state. The payment becomes VERIFIED when the buyer has also confirmed.
Transition an order to a new tracking status. Centralized state machine validates the transition based on delivery method. Seller cannot confirm RECEIVED (only buyer).
Buyer confirms order received. Auto-transitions to COMPLETED after RECEIVED.

get.description: Get tracking information for a buyer order, including status history with actor types (SELLER/BUYER/SYSTEM).
Check if the buyer can leave a review for a completed order. Returns eligibility status and reason.

post.description: Create a review for a completed, verified-purchase order. One review per order. Rating is 1-5 stars with optional comment.

get.description: List all reviews submitted by the current buyer.

patch.description: Update a review (rating and/or comment). Can only update own active reviews.

delete.description: Withdraw (soft-delete) a review. Sets status to WITHDRAWN.

get.description: Get verified buyer reviews for a shop. Public endpoint. Supports sorting (newest/oldest/highest/lowest) and rating filter.

message.example: Account created. Please activate your account.

shop_id.description: The shop UUID to assign the employee to

variant_id.description: The variant UUID to add stock for
The variant UUID to record sale for

employee_id.description: Optional employee UUID if sale is by an employee

delivery_method.description: Delivery method (empty string if not yet selected)

accepted_at.description: Tracking: when order was accepted by seller

denomination_breakdown.description: JSON string with denomination counts, e.g. {"50":1,"20":0,"10":0,"5":0,"1":0}

closing_amount.description: Null if session is still open

difference.description: Actual minus expected (positive = overage, negative = shortage)

use_points.description: Whether to include point redemption in the preview

maximum_usable_points.description: Max points usable, capped by the configurable max coverage of the order total and the available balance

max_point_coverage.description: Max percent of the order total coverable by points

use_points.description: Redeem points on this order (max 20% of the order total)

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key. Re-submitting the same key returns DUPLICATE_ORDER (409) instead of creating a second order.

points_used.description: Points reserved for this order (consumed on completion, released on reject/cancel)

delivery_fee_base.description: Base delivery fee from shop config

delivery_fee_final.description: Final delivery fee after point discount

points_finalized.description: True after the worker consumes reserved points on payment verification

base_unit_price.description: Price snapshot at order creation before any discount

lifetime_points.description: Points earned in total; determines buyer level

reserved_points.description: Points reserved by pending buyer orders

level.description: Buyer level determined by lifetime points

available.description: Whether this option can be chosen

current_method.description: Currently selected delivery method, if any

use_points_for_delivery.description: Reserve points to discount the delivery fee

products_final_total.description: Final products total after product point discount

status.description: New order status (ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY, READY_FOR_PICKUP, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED)

rating_distribution.description: Map of rating to count, e.g. {"1": 2, "5": 10}
